blockingIssues: In Worked Example 1, Step 2 incorrectly lists '3 C-H single bonds' and '2 remaining C-H bonds' (totaling 5 C-H bonds), but the molecule but-1-en-3-yne (C4H4) only has 4 C-H bonds. The breakdown given (3+1+1+1+2) sums up to 8, yet the step incorrectly concludes with 7 sigma bonds. It should be explicitly listed as 4 C-H sigma bonds and 3 C-C sigma bonds, summing accurately to 7.

In Self-Check 2, the answer text contains a typo for the second molecule of Option A. It reads 'CH3OCH2CH3' (methoxyethane, C3H8O) instead of 'CH3OCH2CH2CH3' (1-methoxypropane, C4H10O). This typo creates a molecular formula mismatch, rendering the explanation technically incorrect.
